subject: general
question: The volume of a metallic cylindrical pipe is 1232 cm³. If its external radius is 7 cm and thickness is 2 cm, then the length of the pipe (correct to one decimal place) ( in cm) is: (Take pi =(22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Inner radius (r)** = **External radius (R)** − **Thickness** = 7 − 2 = 5 cm.

Volume of hollow cylinder = π × (R² − r²) × h

1232 = (22/7) × (7² − 5²) × h ⇒ 1232 = (22/7) × 24 × h

h = (1232 × 7) ÷ (22 × 24) = 8624 ÷ 528 ≈ 16.33 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Volume (V)** = 1232 cm³

**External radius (R)** = 7 cm

**Thickness (t)** = 2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **hollow cylindrical pipe** = π(R² − r²)h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b711afbf504c2bb03e6c3b8014159e3f03ca4dcabf777ed5afb269d05ccd90ff.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Inner radius (r)** = R − thickness = 7 − 2 = 5 cm

⇒ 1232 = (22/7) × (7² − 5²) × h

⇒ 1232 = (22/7) × (49 − 25) × h

⇒ 1232 = (22/7) × 24 × h

⇒ h = (1232 × 7) ÷ (22 × 24)

⇒ h = 8624 ÷ 528

⇒ h = 16.333... cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16.3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hollow Cylinder Surface Area

Total Surface Area = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r). It includes inner CSA, outer CSA, and the area of two rings.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

External CSA = 2πRh and Internal CSA = 2πrh.

Volume Calculation

The volume of material in a hollow pipe is the difference between the volumes of the outer and inner cylinders: V = πh(R² − r²).</p
